title_zh: 为大型雕塑草图留出观看距离

scenario.label_zh: 大型雕塑草图的空间评议
scenario.goal_zh: 讨论尺寸带来的效果并约定在草图中调整摆放位置

context_zh: 艺术家 Marta 与展览策划 Ken 评议一件尚未制作的大型雕塑草图。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.text: Here’s the sketch. The sculpture would stand just inside the entrance.

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: Its sheer size could stun visitors, but would they have room to step back and see the whole shape?

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.text: Not in that position. They would mostly see the base as they came in.

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: Could it go in the central hall instead? There’s more viewing distance in that layout.

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.text: Yes. I’ll redraw it there and show the space around it.

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: Let’s review that version before deciding on the final placement.

targets.sense_zh: 纯粹是或仅凭其程度而显著的
